sources.shortCitation: BnF, Tino Rossi, Vivons l’amour / Un baiser de femme, Columbia DF 1606
sources.fullCitation: Tino Rossi, voice. “Vivons l’amour, vivons la vie,” with orchestra conducted by Pierre Chagnon, and “Un baiser de femme sous un ciel de feu,” with orchestra conducted by Marcel Cariven; music by Walter Jurmann and Bronisław Kaper; words by Henri Varna, Léo Lelièvre and Marc-Cab. Columbia DF 1606, matrices CL 5022 and CL 5038. One 25 cm 78 rpm disc. Bibliothèque nationale de France, Catalogue général, notice FRBNF37826058, ARK ark:/12148/cb37826058w.
